education.qualification: Diploma in Information and Communication Technology (Applications Development)

taskify.name: Taskify | Campus Task & Equipment Marketplace
taskify.tech: Node.js, Express, MySQL, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, REST API, JWT, Render
bullets: Built and deployed a full-stack marketplace where students post tasks, hire services, buy items and rent equipment.
Designed a 26-table MySQL schema (39 foreign keys, 76 indexes) behind a REST API with separate routes, controllers and services.
Secured the platform with JWT authentication, TOTP two-factor sign-in for admins, bcrypt password hashing, Helmet security headers, rate limiting and server-side input validation.
Stopped double bookings and duplicate payments under concurrent use with row-level locks and conditional updates.
Wrote 134 automated tests across 13 test suites (Node.js test runner) covering rentals, sales, disputes and tasks, all passing.
Integrated Cloudinary image uploads, Nodemailer email and web push notifications.

stokvault.name: StokVault | Stokvel Contribution & Payout Platform
stokvault.meta: Enterprise Java | Group project (DICT312) for UMP Centre for Entrepreneurship, Cooperatives & Innovation
stokvault.tech: Java 21, Jakarta EE 11 (Faces, REST, EJB, CDI, JPA, JMS, Batch), Payara Server, PostgreSQL, Maven, Docker, GitHub Actions, JUnit 5
bullets: Delivered a layered Jakarta EE application that replaces WhatsApp and notebook record-keeping for stokvels, with role-based access for treasurers, committee members and members.
Automated payout eligibility with a scheduled Jakarta Batch job and required a second approver (four-eyes check) for high-value payouts.
Built a SHA-256 hash-chained, tamper-evident audit log, with a PostgreSQL trigger that blocks updates and deletes.
Protected sensitive data with PBKDF2 password hashing, AES-256-GCM encryption of ID numbers and account lockout after failed logins.
Sent SMS, WhatsApp and email notifications asynchronously through a JMS queue with retries and a dead-letter queue.
Set up GitHub Actions CI to build the app, run 49 JUnit 5 unit tests and 48 end-to-end API checks, and build a Docker image.

ump-events.name: UMP Events | Campus Event Booking Website
ump-events.meta: PHP web application | Started as a 2nd-year group project, since rebuilt
ump-events.tech: PHP 8.2, MySQL, PDO, MVC, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Apache (XAMPP)
bullets: Rebuilt a procedural PHP site into a framework-free MVC application with a router, middleware, controllers, services and repositories.
Students browse and book events and get a digital ticket with a booking reference; admins manage events, track fill rates and export attendee lists to CSV.
Prevented overbooking with database transactions, row locks and unique constraints.
Hardened security against common OWASP risks: prepared statements, CSRF tokens, a strict Content-Security-Policy, secure sessions, login throttling and safe file uploads.
Built responsive, accessible pages with dark mode, keyboard support and ARIA labels.

fuelsa.name: FUEL SA | Fuel Ordering & Station Management System
fuelsa.tech: Java 17, JavaFX 21, FXML, CSS, SQLite (JDBC), Maven, BulkSMS REST API
bullets: Built a desktop app where customers register vehicles and request fuel with a live cost estimate, and admins approve or reject requests from a dashboard.
Added admin analytics: revenue, profit, a weekly sales chart and top customers.
Integrated the BulkSMS REST API to send request status updates by SMS.
Stored passwords as salted PBKDF2 hashes and kept API credentials out of source code using environment variables.
Organised code into controllers, DAOs, models and services, with a demo mode that loads sample data.

healthwise.name: HealthWise | AI Symptom Checker Android App
healthwise.tech: Java, Android SDK, XML, Material Components 3, Room (SQLite), Retrofit, Gson, AlarmManager, Hugging Face API
bullets: Built a native Android app with a four-step guided symptom check that ranks likely conditions with confidence scores and gives urgency advice.
Integrated an AI chat assistant through the Hugging Face Inference API using Retrofit, keeping conversation context and suggesting follow-up questions.
Stored check history, health profile and medication data in Room, with schema migrations that keep user data across upgrades.
Built pill reminders with AlarmManager, BroadcastReceiver and notifications that work when the app is closed, with a mark-as-taken action.
Used a repository pattern to separate Activities (UI) from data access and scoring logic.
Designed light and dark themes with Material 3, voice input for symptoms and adaptive icons; supports Android 7.0 (API 24) and up.

stams.name: STAMS | Student Accommodation Management System
stams.meta: Mobile app + REST API | In progress
stams.tech: Java 21, Spring Boot, Spring Security, JWT, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, PostgreSQL, Flutter, Dart, Postman
bullets: Building a Flutter mobile app and Spring Boot REST API for landlords to manage properties, rooms and student residents.
Designing a maintenance workflow where students report issues with photos, track them from Reported to Resolved, and nudge landlords when an issue stalls.
Implementing JWT authentication with Spring Security and testing API endpoints in Postman.
Next phases: Swagger/OpenAPI docs, unit tests, Docker and GitHub Actions CI/CD.

wan.name: Two-Campus WAN Design & Configuration
wan.tech: Cisco Packet Tracer, TCP/IP, IP addressing & subnetting, routing, switching, wireless LAN
bullets: Designed and configured a wide area network linking two campuses, each with 5 departments of 5 computers.
Segmented wireless access with separate SSIDs for student, staff and guest networks at both campuses.
Configured inter-campus routing and verified end-to-end connectivity with ping tests between campuses.

cvs.docTitle: Malwandla Hlongwane CV - Junior Database Developer
cvs.summary: Final-year Diploma in ICT (Applications Development) student at the University of Mpumalanga with hands-on relational database work across five real applications. Designed a 26-table MySQL schema with 39 foreign keys and 76 indexes, built a tamper-evident audit log in PostgreSQL, and used transactions and row locks to prevent double bookings. Skilled in ER modelling, normalisation, SQL, indexing, data security and connecting databases to REST APIs. Seeking a Junior Database Developer, SQL Developer, Junior DBA or data-focused graduate role.

MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Room (Android), MySQL Workbench, pgAdmin, phpMyAdmin
SQL:
DDL and DML, complex joins, subqueries, set operators, aggregate and analytical functions, stored procedures, triggers
Design:
ER modelling, normalisation, conceptual, logical and physical data models, primary and foreign keys, constraints, indexing
Integrity & Performance:
transactions, row-level locking, concurrency control, query optimisation, schema migrations
Data Security:
prepared statements (SQL injection prevention), password hashing, AES-256 encryption at rest, audit logging, role-based access
Application Integration:
PDO, JDBC, JPA/Hibernate, mysql2 (Node.js), REST APIs, CSV export; Java, PHP, JavaScript
Also covered in coursework:

projects.meta: Full-stack web application | MySQL database design
extraBullets: Designed a 26-table MySQL schema with 39 foreign keys and 76 indexes supporting users, tasks, sales, rentals, disputes and payments.
Prevented duplicate bookings and payments under concurrent use with row-level locks and conditional updates.
Combined 28 database repair scripts into one ordered runner and regenerated the schema file, verified against the live database (325 columns) with no rows lost.
Covered database-driven workflows with 134 automated tests across 13 suites, all passing.
Modelled contributions, payout cycles and per-group member roles in PostgreSQL using JPA entities.
Built a SHA-256 hash-chained audit log, with a PostgreSQL trigger that blocks UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE on audit records.
Encrypted ID numbers at rest with AES-256-GCM and enforced uniqueness with an HMAC.
Moved all SQL into one repository class per table, using PDO prepared statements to prevent SQL injection.
Prevented overbooking with transactions, row locks and a unique constraint on bookings.
Built admin reports (fill rates, recent bookings) and CSV attendee exports protected against formula injection.
Designed Room (SQLite) tables for check history, pill reminders, dose logs and health profile, with migrations that keep user data across schema versions.
Built an SQLite database with DAO classes over JDBC for customers, vehicles and fuel requests, feeding revenue and top-customer reports.
